## 1. How this was derived (new evidence this round)

```text
vendor TAR (sha-verified)
 -> carve_upgrade.py -> rootfs.es (gzip) + customer.es (UBIFS) + 9 more partitions
 -> rootfs gzip-cpio parse (560 entries, custom tools/fw/extract_rootfs_cpio.py)
     -> bootconfig/bin/cardv EN/VI (1,225,780 B, sha matches CARDV_RAW_ADAS_CONTRACT_V1)
     -> lib/libflow.so EN==VI byte-identical; libADAS_LINUX.so, license helper, lib/cardv identical
     => rootfs delta is EXACTLY {cardv, sc7a20.ko} (independently re-confirmed)
 -> customer UBIFS inventory (tools/fw/ubifs_ls.py, no decompression, 227 files both)
     -> 12 size/comp diffs: adas bin, 7 audio WAVs, version_base64, 3 wifi CGI files
     -> FCW.wav + HMW.wav IDENTICAL; LDW/PCW/SAG/VB/activated/fail/updating re-recorded in VI
     -> audio asset names prove stock warning classes: FCW/HMW/LDW/PCW/SAG/VB
 -> model.txt identical (d0/v_a/v_t/p_r/road/tl -> 1..6.img); git_commit differs
 -> cardv ELF byte search (tools/fw/cardv_contract_evidence.py -> EVIDENCE_CARDV_CONTRACT.json)
 -> libflow.so symbol search (flow:: symbols, 24012/127.0.0.1 defaults, subscribe/unsubscribe)
 -> adas uncompressed-block scan (tools/fw/adas_plainblock_evidence.py, 1,701 plain blocks)
```

## 2. cardv JSON/screen contract — CONFIRMED (byte-context in EN cardv .rodata)

Function-level cross-check (local readelf, `tools/fw/cardv_symdiff.py` ->
`docs/reverse/EVIDENCE_CARDV_SYMDIFF.json`): EN 4478 / VI 4476 dynsyms, same
EN-only 4 + VI-only 2 names, same 9 size-changed functions as CARDV_STATIC_DIFF_V1 —
prior claims independently re-derived from the original binaries.

```text
{"type":1600, "uuid":"GPSLevel", "level":%d}          @ ~0xf33f6 (src/module_websocket.cpp)
{"type":1100, "uuid":"DispBrightSet", "brightness":%d}
{"type":1601, "uuid":"GPSSpeed", "speed":%d}          (template in EN TOO; only sender fn is VI-only)
{"type":3000, "uuid":"AdasStatus", "status":%s}
```

Function-string deltas CONFIRMED: `SendGPSSpeedToScreen` + `nmea_BDGSV2info_na` VI-ONLY;
`nmea_satinfo` EN-ONLY. All other screen senders (`SendADASInfoToScreen`,
`SendGPSInfoToScreen`, backlight/display/storage/wifi/audio) in BOTH.

## 3. libflow transport — HIGH-CONFIDENCE structure, CONFIRMED library identity

`lib/libflow.so` byte-identical EN/VI with `subscribe`x7 / `unsubscribe`x2 /
`RealClientInfo::DoSubscribe` / `OnRecvWSBinaryFrame` / `OutMsg` / `24012`+`127.0.0.1`
defaults / `websocket`+`Upgrade` paths. `AdasScreenService` and `vehicle` topics are
absent from libflow.so — they are adas-side (confinement proof). Outer envelope
`{time,source,topic,data=BIN}` + subscribe frame stay HIGH-CONFIDENCE until pcap.
Port `26012` override HIGH-CONFIDENCE (adas-side). Physical interface UNKNOWN.

## 4. adas string layer — HONESTLY BLOCKED (with exact reproduction path)

adas `.text/.rodata` live in 1,140 LZO blocks of customer UBIFS (inode 136 EN /
199 VI); Windows host has no liblzo2, so direct string proof is pending. What IS
proven without LZO: inode/size/block counts match prior verified extraction;
1,701 plain blocks are high-entropy model/interstitial (no ScreenService strings —
expected); 2 trigram hits (`fcw` blk 2280, `ttc` blk 2051) are coincidental
(high-entropy context, discounted); block-0 LZO stream opens with literal-run
`0x1a` yielding `\x7fELF` (payload slicing validated; oracle for LZO work).
Key routing (`vehicle/vehicleWarning` etc.) stays HIGH-CONFIDENCE via prior
callsite disassembly + adas-side confinement. Reproduce after LZO:

```sh
python3 tools/fw/ubifs_extract_file.py <customer.ubifs> /minieye/adas/adas -o adas
# expect EN sha256 0dcc69828078e4e243b17ca9508d15ca6b47a3c2f6ec59d6c20bc5b5e9c94043 (11,636,008 B)
# expect VI sha256 997b71c27edcd49c2b0465333f53274e73ec1086023af972a39a22dfa95527d1 (11,653,870 B)
```

## 5. Normalized-field verdicts (binding on StockADASProvider)

SOLE warning drivers (HIGH-CONFIDENCE): `fcw` field -> fcw.active;
`is_danger` -> pcw.active; `deviate_state` -> ldw.active; `is_crucial` -> lead.
Everything else RAW-ONLY (preserved, never promotes): `warning_level`,
`headway/is_key/label/type/poly/units`, `headway_warning/vb_warning/sag_warning`
(class existence CONFIRMED via WAV assets, trigger mapping UNKNOWN).
UNKNOWN (stay empty): camera TSR limit, `ScreenAudioMsg`, physical transport,
WS path/source, all units/enums. No min-distance lead fallback (F11).

- V1 `M4_STATIC_PROTOCOL` schemas: retained as HIGH-CONFIDENCE routing, demoted

- New: audio-asset class proof, EN-has-GPSSpeed-template nuance, libflow.so
